note: Bands are heuristic tertiles on the 1-6 scale (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice), proportionally rescaled from the original 1-5 convention. Fine for a reflective tool; revisit once you have cohort data to set real thresholds.

bands.label: Reserved
bands.description: Draws energy from solitude or small groups; tends to observe before engaging, and doesn't need to be the center of attention.

bands.label: Situationally social
bands.description: Comfortable in company but doesn't need it constantly; energy shifts with context and mood.

bands.label: Outgoing
bands.description: Energized by people and activity; starts conversations easily and is comfortable being noticed.

bands.label: Direct
bands.description: Prioritizes honesty and personal judgment over smoothing things over; comfortable with friction if it serves the truth.

bands.label: Selectively warm
bands.description: Cooperative with people who've earned trust, more guarded with those who haven't.

bands.label: Warm
bands.description: Quick to sympathize and accommodate others; tends to put relationships and harmony first.

bands.label: Spontaneous
bands.description: Prefers flexibility over fixed plans; can let structure slide when something more interesting comes up.

bands.label: Adaptive planner
bands.description: Organized when it matters, relaxed about the rest.

bands.label: Structured
bands.description: Reliable, detail-oriented, and driven by follow-through; discomfort with loose ends.

bands.label: Steady
bands.description: Generally even-keeled; stress doesn't easily throw off mood or focus.

bands.label: Responsive
bands.description: Feels things fairly intensely but recovers with some space or time.

bands.label: Sensitive
bands.description: Feels emotional shifts strongly and quickly; benefits from deliberate regulation practices.

bands.label: Practical
bands.description: Prefers the concrete and proven over the abstract or experimental; values what's tested and useful.

bands.label: Curious within limits
bands.description: Open to new ideas selectively, especially when they connect to existing interests.

bands.label: Imaginative
bands.description: Drawn to ideas, patterns, and novelty; enjoys abstract or unconventional thinking.
